contract.goal: Carry out the change described by the issue in the repository at base_sha

problem.exists: The repository carries no contribution guide, so a new contributor infers how to build and test it from the source tree.
problem.expected: A CONTRIBUTING.md at the repository root states how to build the project, how to run its tests, and what a change must satisfy before it is proposed.
problem.diverges: Nothing in the repository states the contribution procedure, so every contributor reconstructs one and they do not reconstruct the same one.

sources.claim: what the repository is and how it is built

in: add CONTRIBUTING.md at the repository root
out: changing any file other than README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md

acceptance.statement: CONTRIBUTING.md exists at the repository root and states the build command, the test command, and the standard a change must meet before it is proposed.
acceptance.verification: the diff adds CONTRIBUTING.md; read it for all three statements — a missing one fails this criterion

acceptance.statement: README.md points a reader at CONTRIBUTING.md.
acceptance.verification: the diff modifies README.md so that it names CONTRIBUTING.md
